scope: Local source-definition and explicit citation inventory; no external source validation.
method: Source definitions are bracketed uppercase IDs ending in at least two digits in Markdown headings under references/. Entry ends at next same-or-higher heading. Uses scan literal individual bracketed IDs in handbook, platforms, adaptations and frameworks; citation ranges, prose mentions and implicit support are not expanded. Locator detection is lexical, not reachability or authority verification. IDs may bundle multiple publications and may overlap across ledgers.
